name: 标签规则
description: 白底矩形宽度、标签位置、不遮挡箭头标记等约束

rules.name: 标签白底不遮挡箭头
rules.detect: function(eventType, payload) { return (eventType === 'lint-fail' || eventType === 'review') && payload.error && payload.error.includes('label'); }
rules.analyze: function(payload) { return { rootCause: '白底矩形宽度过大，覆盖了箭头标记', impact: '箭头不可见，违反 §2.4.6 ST-16', suggestedFix: '缩窄白底至刚好包住文字，矩形右边界 ≤ 箭头尖 x - 8px', severity: 'high' }; }

rules.name: 标签位置偏移
rules.detect: function(eventType, payload) { return eventType === 'lint-fail' && payload.error && payload.error.includes('position'); }
rules.analyze: function(payload) { return { rootCause: '标签位置偏移，不在水平段中央', impact: '不美观，阅读困难', suggestedFix: '将标签 x 坐标移至水平段中央', severity: 'low' }; }
